# awscc_mediatailor_program (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::MediaTailor::Program



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `ad_breaks` (Attributes List) The ad break configuration settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ad_breaks))
- `arn` (String) The ARN of the program.
- `audience_media` (Attributes List) The list of AudienceMedia defined in program. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--audience_media))
- `channel_name` (String) The name of the channel for this Program.
- `clip_range` (Attributes) The clip range configuration settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clip_range))
- `creation_time` (String) The timestamp of when the program was created.
- `duration_millis` (Number) The duration of the live program in milliseconds.
- `live_source_name` (String) The name of the LiveSource for this Program.
- `program_name` (String) The name of the Program.
- `schedule_configuration` (Attributes) The schedule configuration settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule_configuration))
- `scheduled_start_time` (String) The date and time that the program is scheduled to start.
- `source_location_name` (String) The name of the source location.
- `vod_source_name` (String) The name that's used to refer to a VOD source.

<a id="nestedatt--ad_breaks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ad_breaks`

Read-Only:

- `ad_break_metadata` (Attributes List) Defines a list of key/value pairs that MediaTailor generates within the EXT-X-ASSET tag for SCTE35_ENHANCED output. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ad_breaks--ad_break_metadata))
- `message_type` (String) The SCTE-35 ad insertion type.
- `offset_millis` (Number) How long (in milliseconds) after the beginning of the program that an ad starts.
- `slate` (Attributes) Slate VOD source configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ad_breaks--slate))
- `splice_insert_message` (Attributes) Splice insert message configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ad_breaks--splice_insert_message))
- `time_signal_message` (Attributes) The SCTE-35 time_signal message configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ad_breaks--time_signal_message))

### Nested Schema for `schedule_configuration.transition`

Read-Only:
